pages.text: The Advanced Xianqiao Interface keeps the plain interface's nine mixed cache slots and owner binding, but applies the plain interface's six-face pull/push semantics to every container inside a configurable bounding box, ideal for large-scale automation over many containers.

The six faces stay Pull/Push/Off three-state with the left-side Active Pull / Active Push toggles. Pull: on an enabled pull face, extract all interactive content (items/fluids/power/chemicals) from each in-area container through that configured face into Xianqiao, not limited to configured targets. Push: on an enabled push face, export the cache slots that permit that face into the in-area containers.

The ⚙ configuration page offers advanced-stabilized-ruin options: xyz/+xzy range size and offset, frequency, preview toggle, enabled, access (poll-skip/force-poll), split (item-by-item/group-by-group) and order (far-first/near-first). The range defaults to 1×1×1 excluding itself, so grow it to cover the target containers.

With the preview toggle on, the world draws a white selection box; interaction faces stay white translucent, PULL faces gain green translucent and PUSH faces red translucent, live with server config. Directionless Botania spark/mana and Ars source interactions remain available.

Release: clearing or retargeting a cache slot atomically returns its non-empty buffer to Xianqiao; empty-hand left-click on a configured slot returns and clears it; breaking the interface also returns every cache to Xianqiao first, keeping only un-placeable overflow in compact dropped-item data that resumes on re-placement.
